work.description: The first of four homilies transmitted and printed under Gregory Thaumaturgus's name but placed by the Ante-Nicene Fathers editors among his dubious or spurious writings. The repository records the work as anonymous and does not use it as secure evidence for Gregory or for a third-century date.
